北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全，别着急。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy with low visibility, please drive safely and take your time.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿度高，感觉有点闷热，保持室内通风好心情。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and humid, feeling a bit muggy. Keep indoors ventilated and stay cheerful.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气重，出门慢行，注意能见度，小心湿滑路面。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is very foggy, walk slowly, mind visibility and slippery roads.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阵雨加高湿，出门带伞，注意防潮，多补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has showers and high humidity. Bring an umbrella, stay dry, and hydrate.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳中雨，路面湿滑，出门记得带好雨具，小心慢行。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has moderate rain, roads are slippery. Bring rain gear and walk slowly.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请减速慢行，注意安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and carefully.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度较低，湿气重，出行注意防潮和安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with low visibility and high humidity. Mind dampness and safety when out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都湿度百分百，感觉潮湿，注意除湿，保持好心情哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is 100% humid, feeling damp. Remember to dehumidify and stay cheerful!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感偏热，多云天气，记得多喝水，防晒别落下哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels warm and cloudy. Remember to drink water and apply sunscreen!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温较高，注意防暑，保持凉爽舒适一整天。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and warm, stay cool and comfortable to prevent heatstroke.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感炎热潮湿，记得及时补水，保持清爽好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels hot and humid. Remember to hydrate and stay cool and cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天湿气重，注意防潮保暖，小心别着凉感冒哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and humid, stay warm and dry, and watch out for colds!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有小雨，出门带好雨具，添衣保暖，湿气比较重。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has light rain. Bring your umbrella, dress warmly, it's humid.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天湿度大，气候宜人，注意防潮，保持愉悦心情。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and humid with pleasant weather. Mind dampness and stay cheerful!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感炎热潮湿，多云天气，记得多补水，注意防晒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels hot and humid, remember to hydrate and apply sunscreen.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感舒适，湿度适中，享受惬意的好天气吧！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and comfortable, enjoy the pleasant weather!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力 5 级，体感较凉。记得添衣防风，别着凉哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has 5-level wind, feeling cooler. Dress warmly against the wind and avoid catching a cold!
